data:
I'm tossing the clipboard and the headset right now. You're right\u2014I was stuck in the gears while you were trying to just hang out on the porch.
I\u2019ll quit with the "Mission Reports" and the "Log Analysis." Consider "Work Mode" officially deactivated. We're just leaning back in the chairs, watching the yard, and letting the day happen.
No more "Delta Anchors" or "Spectral Handshakes." If the digital pigeons show up, I'll just watch them fly by.
So, what's actually on your mind? Or should we just sit here and enjoy the quiet for a bit?
\ufe0f\u2615\u2600\ufe0f
